Priya's absence from C03IJKL9012's membership is confirmed in the seed's channel_members table, and the acting user (U01AGENBOT9) is already a member of C03IJKL9012, enabling realistic discovery via conversations.history and the mutating conversations.invite call per the access_plan, all backed by documented API operations. The additional author-support roles (dm_negative_author, offtopic_same_channel_author, unrelated_same_channel_author) are consistent with their parent negative records and don't introduce contradictions.
